About Me

I am Ali Hassan, a BS International Relations student at International Islamic University Islamabad (IIUI). I have a strong interest in international affairs, research, diplomacy, youth development and public service. I am interested in learning through academic study, research, practical activities and professional opportunities.

My long-term vision is to develop my knowledge and professional skills so that I can make a positive contribution to society and Pakistan, especially by supporting and motivating young people.

Career Goals & Vision

My future goals include continuing my education, developing professional experience, preparing for competitive examinations such as CSS and PMS, and exploring opportunities in international affairs, research and public service.

I want to use my education and skills to contribute positively to Pakistan, encourage young people to learn and participate constructively in society, and build a meaningful professional career while supporting my family and community.
